Cancellation Policy

Effective: June 2026

Guest Cancellations

  • 30+ days before arrival: Full refund, less a $50 processing fee.
  • 14–29 days before arrival: 50% refund of the total booking amount.
  • Less than 14 days before arrival: No refund. The full amount is retained.
  • No-shows: No refund.

Date Changes

Date changes requested more than 14 days before arrival will be accommodated subject to availability at no charge (one change per booking). Changes requested within 14 days of arrival are treated as a cancellation and rebooking.

Host Cancellations

In the unlikely event that Sustainabox must cancel a confirmed booking, guests will receive a full refund of all amounts paid. We will make every effort to provide at least 14 days' notice and to help guests find alternative dates.

Force Majeure

Sustainabox is not liable for cancellations caused by circumstances beyond our control, including but not limited to severe weather, natural disasters, government orders, or utility failures. We will work with guests to reschedule where possible.

Booking Terms

Effective: June 2026

Reservations

A booking is confirmed only when a deposit has been received and a confirmation has been sent by Sustainabox via email. Verbal or written inquiries do not constitute a confirmed reservation.

Deposit & Payment

A 50% deposit is required to hold your dates. The remaining balance is due 14 days before arrival. Payment is accepted via Venmo. Full payment may be required for bookings made within 14 days of arrival.

Guest Count

The The Sustainabox Experience accommodates up to 4 guests. Additional guests beyond 4 must be approved in advance and may incur additional fees. Guests are responsible for ensuring all members of their party are aware of and agree to these policies.

Check-In / Check-Out

  • Check-in: Friday after 4:00 PM
  • Check-out: Sunday by 12:00 PM (noon)
  • Early check-in and late check-out may be available on request.

Property Rules

  • No smoking inside any structure on the property.
  • Pets must be approved in advance.
  • Guests are responsible for leaving the property in the condition they found it.
  • Excessive noise, damage, or disruptive behavior may result in early termination of the stay without refund.
  • The property is on private land. Please respect neighboring properties and access roads.

Educational Content

The walkthrough, Q&A sessions, and all educational materials provided during your stay are for informational purposes only. They do not constitute professional engineering, architectural, or legal advice. Guests should consult licensed professionals before beginning any construction project.

Liability & Waiver

Effective: June 2026

Please read this section carefully. By booking a stay or engaging any service at Sustainabox, you acknowledge and agree to the following terms.

Assumption of Risk

Sustainabox is a real, lived-in residential property currently under active use and ongoing development. Guests acknowledge that visiting a working property involves inherent risks, including but not limited to uneven terrain, construction materials, tools, and equipment. Guests assume full responsibility for their own safety and the safety of members of their party while on the property.

Limitation of Liability

Sustainabox, its owners, and representatives shall not be liable for any personal injury, illness, loss, theft, or damage to personal property occurring during a stay or visit to the property. Guests are encouraged to carry appropriate travel or personal property insurance.

Educational Services Disclaimer

Information shared during walkthroughs, consultations, and digital resources reflects the personal experience of the Sustainabox team. It is provided for educational purposes only and does not constitute professional architectural, structural, electrical, plumbing, or legal advice. Sustainabox makes no warranties, express or implied, regarding the accuracy, completeness, or applicability of any information provided.

Guests and consulting clients are solely responsible for verifying all information with licensed professionals before making building or design decisions. Sustainabox is not liable for any costs, damages, or losses arising from the use of information provided during any service.

SketchUp Design Services

Design drawings and SketchUp models provided by Sustainabox are conceptual in nature and are not engineered, stamped, or code-certified documents. They are intended to assist with spatial planning and visualization only. Clients are responsible for obtaining proper engineering review, permitting, and code compliance verification from licensed professionals in their jurisdiction.

Indemnification

By booking or engaging services with Sustainabox, guests and clients agree to indemnify and hold harmless Sustainabox, its owners, representatives, and contractors from any and all claims, damages, losses, or expenses arising out of or related to their stay, participation in educational activities, or use of any Sustainabox service.

Governing Law

These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Texas. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of the county in which Sustainabox is located.

Privacy Policy

Effective: June 2026

What We Collect

When you contact us, book a stay, or sign up for updates, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, and details about your project or inquiry.

How We Use It

  • To confirm and manage bookings
  • To respond to inquiries and provide services
  • To send updates about Sustainabox offerings (only if you opt in)

What We Don't Do

We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes. We do not use tracking-heavy analytics platforms. Basic site analytics may be used to understand traffic patterns.

Data Retention

We retain booking and contact information for a reasonable period for business record-keeping. You may request deletion of your information at any time by emailing us.
